scraped.scraped_description:
mySociety is a not-for-profit social enterprise, based in the UK but working with partners internationally.
            We build and share digital technologies that help people be active citizens, across the three areas of
            Democracy, Transparency, and Community.

name: mySociety Datasets and APIs
tagline: Open datasets and APIs for democracy, transparency, and community engagement
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
news_articles: Guardian: mySociety's transparency tools reshape UK politics
Reuters: Open data platforms drive democratic engagement
TechCrunch: mySociety expands international civic tech initiatives
academic_citations: Transparency and accountability in digital governance (Google Scholar)
Civic technology platforms and citizen participation (SSRN)
Open data infrastructure for democratic institutions (OpenAlex)
policy_outcomes: Influenced UK Freedom of Information Act implementation
Contributed to international open data standards
outcome_methodology: observational studies, case studies, stakeholder interviews
failure_modes: Data synchronization delays with government sources
curation_criteria: Community-driven with editorial board oversight; prioritizes datasets with public interest value and democratic relevance
contributor_governance: Open contribution model with documented contribution guidelines; community review process for new datasets
disparity_tracking: Monitors geographic coverage gaps and works to include underrepresented regions in datasets
community_ownership: Community-driven curation with public feedback mechanisms; advisory board includes civil society representatives
ai_involvement: Limited; primarily used for data processing and API optimization, not core functionality
political_relevance_summary: mySociety Datasets and APIs addresses enabling broader democratic participation and improving government service delivery and transparency. It has documented policy impact.

movement_building_utility.notes: Amplifies advocacy efforts through Open datasets and APIs for democracy, transparency, and community engagement.

generalizability_notes: Open-source codebase enables replication. already deployed internationally across multiple jurisdictions.
